The '''YT-XC''', later known as the "'''mini-fighter'''," was a small explorer craft that could be carried aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]].

==History==
Similar to the [[explorer craft]], the YT-XC was a single-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] exploration [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was developed by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] for use in conjunction with the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. The YT-XC arose from research and development that had gone into the failed [[Freight-Loading External Rover/Legends|freight-loading external rover]] project. The vessel developed huge demand, but in response to concerns from [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]], CEC marketed it only at relief organizations, scientific foundations and licensed industrial prospectors. However, a number of YT-XCs were obtained by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], who modified them and used them as miniature [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="MFOWM" /> For some time, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] operated one aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="TLC">''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
[[File:YT-XC.jpg|thumb|250px|Diagram of an armed YT-XC]]
The YT-XC was designed to be housed within the YT-1300, concealed behind a hatch that outwardly appeared to be a [[Docking ring/Legends|docking ring]].<ref name="MFOWM" /> The ship was large enough to accommodate an adult male [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]].<ref name="TLC" /> The craft was later equipped with two [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]].<ref name="MFOWM" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It was always there; you just never saw it in the films.|[[Mark Boudreaux]], discussing the mini-fighter|<ref name="insider" />}}
The designers of the [[Hasbro]] [[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|Legacy Collection]] ''Millennium Falcon'' included the mini-fighter with the ''Falcon'' because they believed that the ''Falcon''{{'s}} size and bulk relegated the ''Falcon'' to the role of a playset rather than a vehicle. They felt that, in the words of designer [[Mark Boudreaux]], "There had to be some way to fly some part of the ''Falcon'' around."<ref name="insider">{{InsiderCite|106|Millennium Man: The Man Behind the New Millennium Falcon|''Millennium'' Man: The Man Behind the New ''Millennium Falcon''}}</ref>
